recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-53367 unless the Devices work group later revisits DeviceMetric status semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-53367 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 change request asking for explanations on DeviceMetric modifier elements. The approved resolution was to explain why DeviceMetric.status is a modifier and to remove the modifier flag from DeviceMetric.operationalStatus.
initial_application: Jira comments identify HL7/fhir#3945 and merge commit 73cffd7d54e65524a6327ec3211e4a7de7c47112. Implementation commit 533f3383c9746718a840e9c0cc84c987d0cf30be added the DeviceMetric.status isModifierReason and changed DeviceMetric.operationalStatus from isModifier true to false.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists devicemetric as an active DeviceMetric resource owned by the Devices work group, so source/devicemetric/structuredefinition-DeviceMetric.xml is in current build scope. Devices WG minutes from 2025-11-05 record the same 7-0-0 decision. The same PR also addressed FHIR-53309 mapping updates, but that issue is separate from the modifier rationale.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current StructureDefinition marks DeviceMetric.status as a modifier with an isModifierReason explaining entered-in-error and inactive statuses, and DeviceMetric.operationalStatus is explicitly not a modifier.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-53309 was implemented in the same PR and commit but concerns DeviceMetric mapping identities rather than modifier rationale.
